direction: Create one original edge-to-edge widescreen cinematic painting (16:9). Use the accompanying reference contact sheet only for the established Night Nine style: luminous hand-painted adventure game illustration with grounded materials and restrained filmic light. Compose the new shot described below as one full-bleed scene; do not copy the contact-sheet layout, text, frames or typography. No UI or watermark.

shots.c1_escape: Midnight, water-level reverse angle from under a wave looking shoreward at Bellwether. Very distant peaceful silhouettes of the ninth-night procession stand knee deep in the water under the old timber pier. A double line of blue-green phosphorescence rolls toward camera low in the frame; the real harbor and warm windows remain recognizable. Unsettling and quiet, not a disaster. Horizon at 43 percent.
shots.c2_ship: Interior of the immense Veyri ship, looking down a long cathedral of submerged oval amber glass incubation tanks. In the nearest tank at 64 percent frame width and 50 percent height a misted, indistinct human-sized clothed shadow is just beginning to take shape, its face unseen. Honey glass and beads, blue-black water beyond. One subdued blue service light. Full frame no lettering or digits.
shots.c3_archive: In a dark parked car on the wet Washington waterfront, a battered small early-2000s flip phone vibrates by the open case folder, cinematic macro. Camera level with the car dashboard. One luminous, blank, pale blue monochrome rectangular screen in the lower center, just received a message; watercolor harbor lights and one police searchlight far outside the wet glass. Do NOT illustrate writing, numbers or characters on screen.
shots.c4_escape: POV from a rain-wet roadside ditch amid looming Douglas firs. A floodlit utilitarian concrete tunnel far behind on left; a distant white federal vehicle has turned the bend at upper left, its warm twin beams emerging through the wet forest mist. Bent grass very close bottom corners, pre-dawn blue; suspense comes from an approaching light. No people or weapons.
shots.c5_station: The place Stephen remembers: a distant perspective into Row Nine of the alien Gallery beneath Bellwether Bay. Two adjacent warm amber glass sleeper berths at left middle, with the faint sleeping silhouettes of two older adults under modest opaque coverings visible through the honeyed glass. Intimate warm light in a monumental vault of hundreds of quiet berths, immense teal water visible overhead. Faces remain indistinct. No printed row numbers.
shots.c6_jail: A beautiful clean BACKGROUND PLATE for animating a little bakery van later. Low side-on tracking view at dawn of a perfectly empty gray two-lane coastal road across LOWER THIRD, running horizontally from left to right, flat and driveable. Wet asphalt side view with a faded yellow stripe, misty windswept pines on the slope, fishing harbor below, warm morning beyond rain. Road extends outside both sides of frame. NO vehicle, object, pedestrian or animal on it. No painted lettering.
shots.c7_swap: An empty, locked backstage room in the mountain facility after a very public diplomatic ceremony. Wide reverse angle from inside the dark service hatch of a huge stage prop that was passed off as an engine. The hatch has opened to reveal just hollow painted metal rings bolted to a timber scenic bracing frame, old projector, practical worklamp and coiled cable. Thin rays of coastal daylight from the ceremony outside; no futuristic machinery, no people and no lettering.
shots.c8_rig: Extreme wide establishing view of the return underneath Bellwether Bay: a single curving ribbed translucent maintenance passage arcs away through dark teal water toward an amber doorway. A few tiny human silhouettes in distant single file, and well behind them the tiny silhouette of the last postman and beagle following. No close faces or text. A small warm pool of flashlight glow illuminates the ground. Underwater caustics on the glass ceiling.
shots.c9_choir: Clean background plate: a grey Pacific sunset seen low from a rocky headland next to Bellwether with a few very small town lights bottom left. Billowing muted purple-blue cloud layers, delicate long horizon at 62 percent height, nearly black large rolling breakers below; quiet space above them for a huge alien vessel that will be animated separately. NO vessel, planet, aircraft, stars, overlaid waveform or people anywhere in this image. Deep sense of scale.
shots.c10_report: Empty hero-ship background plate for the triumphant takeoff of the Long Patience. View from the timber pier on Bellwether Bay facing a dawn sun off to the right. Golden horizon at 40 percent, calm teal water stretching into the distance; at very bottom left and right, neighboring townspeople seen very small and entirely from behind looking out to sea. Keep the huge CENTER of the water and sky clear for a moving ship composited later. Warm apricot, silver-gold and dark teal, miles of space, overwhelming hope. NO ships anywhere, no craft, no flying objects, no writing.
